title: Twitch CEO Predicts GTA6 Online Mode May Launch Next Year
description: Rockstar remains tight-lipped on GTA 6's multiplayer component, confirming only a single-player campaign for its November 19 launch, but Twitch's CEO predicts it will land next year.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Silence Surrounding GTA 6 Multiplayer

As the release date for *Grand Theft Auto VI* approaches on November 19, anticipation among the gaming community has reached an all-time high. However, Rockstar Games has remained exceptionally tight-lipped regarding the game's potential multiplayer component. As the anticipated successor to the massively popular *Grand Theft Auto Online* from *GTA 5*, fans are eager to know how Rockstar plans to handle online play this time around. Currently, the only confirmed detail is that when GTA 6 arrives on November 19, it will launch strictly with the single-player campaign.

Rockstar has not yet officially commented on whether a dedicated multiplayer mode is in development, nor have they provided any hints about a potential launch window for an online component.

## Industry Speculation: Twitch CEO Weighs In

Despite the lack of official word from the developer, speculation continues to swirl within the gaming industry. According to reports from Eurogamer, Twitch's CEO has publicly expressed the belief that the GTA 6 online multiplayer mode will likely land next year. While this is not an official confirmation from Rockstar Games, it offers an interesting industry perspective on how a platform heavily tied to the game's ecosystem views its rollout strategy.

Given the massive scope of Rockstar titles and the historical precedents of staggered releases, many in the community view a post-launch multiplayer rollout as a logical step, even if it remains unconfirmed by the studio itself.

## Editor's Take

It is hardly surprising that Rockstar is keeping details about GTA 6's online component under wraps, given their traditional marketing approach. While Twitch's CEO has offered a hopeful timeline for next year, players should temper expectations until Rockstar makes an official announcement. For now, focusing on the November 19 single-player launch is the safest bet, with multiplayer likely to follow when the time is right.
